incidents.name: EarningFram
incidents.notes: ENF_ETHLEV ERC4626 withdraw is reentered via ETH callback to withdraw assets twice against stale share accounting.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x863e572b215fd67c855d973f870266cf827aea5e to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x5655c442227371267c165101048e4838a762675d, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (23501340s -> 14174508s)
